segments.text: Please tell me why we're still all working when AI can literally do this.
I gave my AI access to my local computer to handle any task for me.
Vercel released a tool called Agent Desktop, which allows you to spin up agents on your
local computer to have it access any of your windows and files.
So I added it to my personal agent operating system called Halos, which has been collecting
and storing all my personal contacts over the past few weeks.
In what's cool is I connected these agents to my personal data so it literally can
go through my to-do list and check my new iMessages and emails and messages that
come in, and of course because it has all of my contacts, it's able to tackle each one
of these as if I were doing it myself.
But it does make you wonder, will we ever stop working?
